description: Martin Schachner at Graz University of Technology deposited seven critical pedestrian-vehicle interaction scenarios associated with the paper Identifying and Extracting Pedestrian Behavior in Critical Traffic Situations. The files contain pedestrian and car or bicyclist records for the seven scenarios shown in Figure 7 of that paper. OpenSCENARIO .xosc files are accompanied by the StPeter road network in .xodr format, agent catalogues, XML configuration files and PNG plots. The repository states that the scenarios can be resimulated in openPASS v0.11 with the supplied static-agent configuration and basic trajectory follower. Access is public and free under CC BY 4.0. The observations concern one named observation point; its geographic coordinates and the trajectory sampling interval are not stated in the metadata. A specific limitation is that headings at individual timesteps suffer from numerical problems and should not be used. The files provide replay inputs for traffic-agent simulation. Related openPASS records can be located by software name; no exact version-specific catalogue link was established.
